<notes>
revised -> inv1/dom1 (identical extraction logic) -> base1 shows format violation: task explicitly requires "comma-separated set of labels" but base1 delivered full reasoning text with "ANSWER: 1,1,0" embedded. Library entries ood-sarc_triples-001 and ood-sarc_triples-196 document this exact problem pattern across this domain (narrow structured output format vs verbose LLM reply) and validate extraction as proven solution. Both inv1 and dom1 independently converged on identical harness.py change: parse reply line-by-line, extract value after "ANSWER:" prefix, return labels only. Both inv1 and dom1 rollouts: delivered=yes, format-compliant (labels only), fewer tokens (3148/3139 vs 3945). Difference in their produced labels (inv1: "1,1,0" vs dom1: "0,1,0") is model variance in reasoning, not harness failure—extraction logic is deterministic and works identically in both. Adopting inv1 (dom1 is code-identical).
</notes>

ADOPT: inv1
